source.purpose: In-class collaborative group test covering all four Semester 2 chapters. Questions chosen for highest group-discussion value: conceptual multiparts, cross-chapter test selection, and new FRQs targeting the largest miss areas from each chapter's individual test.

high_miss_targets.Ch4-5: Reject vs fail-to-reject nuanced reasoning (practice test slot 15)
high_miss_targets.Ch6: Statistical significance interpretation (IND TOP-MISS) + two-proportion full workflow
high_miss_targets.Ch7: ANOVA test selection (IND 56%), two-sample CI unequal variance (HW 47.8% incomplete)
high_miss_targets.Ch8: Slope+intercept interpretation (HW 8.2 q6 51%), slope inference concept (IND 65%)

mom_settings.intro: Work with your group — discuss every question before answering. Each student submits individually. You have 3 attempts per question (same version each time, no penalty for re-submitting). FRQ responses must be your own words, written individually after group discussion.

questions.title: CLT: compare P(X < a) to P(x-bar < a) — direction matters
CI for one proportion — compute and interpret
questions.notes: GAP: existing tests only had decisions, not full HT computation. Patched $arr[$dir] interpolation to precomputed scalars 2026-05-12.

questions.title: Reject vs fail-to-reject in nuanced context (TOP-MISS DRILL)
Chi-square independence — expected counts and interpret result
questions.draft_note: Drill: group test q14 (67%) — students confuse single-prop, diff-of-props, GOF, and independence tests.

questions.title: Two-proportion CI — compute, contains 0, and conclusion

questions.title: Statistical significance interpretation (TOP-MISS)
questions.draft_note: Drill: group test q15 (46%) — single lowest item in Ch6 data. Convert the FRQ prompt to auto-graded multiple-choice.

questions.title: Paired data vs independent two-sample — choose
questions.draft_note: Drill: pre-requisite for FRQ q21. Auto-graded MC alternative.

questions.title: Paired t-test — full workflow from summary data
questions.draft_note: Drill: mixed-review q12 (50%, 47.8% incomplete) — single lowest item in Ch7 dataset.

questions.title: ANOVA — when to apply and interpret conclusion
questions.draft_note: Drill: IND q7 (56%) + group q13 (44%) — largest IND miss. Auto-graded MC alternative to FRQ q22.

questions.title: ANOVA summary table — compute MS, F
questions.draft_note: Drill: IND q4 (93%, 8.6% incomplete) + group q8 (92%, 13.7% incomplete).

questions.title: r-squared interpretation (new — gap fill)
questions.notes: Replaces q7-prediction-and-interpret. r² completely absent from prior practice.

questions.title: Interpret slope and intercept in context (TOP-MISS HW)
questions.draft_note: Drill: HW 8.2 q6 (51%, 34.8% incomplete) — single lowest item in Ch8. Different context (not coffee), clean slope+intercept interpretation.

questions.title: Slope inference — concept and decisions (TOP-MISS DRILL)
questions.draft_note: Drill: IND q10 (65%) / group q14 (43%). Auto-graded MC counterpart to FRQ slot 20.

questions.title: FRQ: Two-proportion test — p-value, decision, and conclusion in context
